نغتدي (form VIII)
# نَغْتَدِي (naḡtadī) /naɣ.ta.diː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
# نَغْتَدِيَ (naḡtadiya) /naɣ.ta.di.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَدَى (iḡtadā)
